title: Custom lab automation via BAHU
tables: Research institutes, biotech startups, QC labs and technical collaborators with non-standard workflows.
Labs stitch together incubators, cameras, pumps and scripts without one traceable orchestration layer.
BAHU protocol composer; adapters; scheduler; robotics; environment control; PIMS; simulation/dry-run mode.
Model the workflow -> bind approved device adapters -> simulate -> risk review -> run with interlocks -> capture events/data -> refine under version control.
Executable protocol, synchronized device events, complete run record, exceptions and reusable template.
Turns a bespoke hardware collection into a visible, repeatable workflow without hard-coding every experiment into the core product.
Custom workflows are not automatically validated. Adapter failures, timing, units, unsafe commands and device ownership must be addressed with conformance testing and bounded permissions.
